name: download-install
title: Download and install
description: Simulate, then the real install: per package Package(downloading) and ItemProgress 50/100 while Speed, RemainingTime and DownloadSizeRemaining fall, then commit/update with Package(updating)/ItemProgress/Package(finished), cleanup, success. GetUpdates afterwards is empty. The real install keeps its finished transaction for 5 s before Destroy, as packagekitd does ("already finished, so waiting to timeout"): in that gap GetTransactionList no longer lists it, but its properties still answer.
